Subject: Redwood discovery + next steps

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for taking time today — appreciated the context on your latency-sensitive recommender and the multi-region rollout plans. Quick recap from our call and suggested next steps so we're aligned: 

1) What we heard
- Primary: reduce 99th percentile latency for batch scoring from ~1.8s to <500ms for interactive workflows.
- Secondary: consistent model behavior across eu/us regions and ability to pin model versions for audits.

2) How Redwood helps (short)
- Dedicated pools with region-aware routing and KV prefix caching to keep tail latency down for cold starts.
- Model quantization profiles and autoscale policies that preserve throughput while reducing unit cost.

3) Proposed next steps
- I'll send over a one-pager and a ballpark cost estimate for a pilot (week of 6/15). [attachment: redwood-one-pager.pdf]
- If that looks good, propose a 30-45 minute pilot kickoff with your infra and ML engineering (suggest Wed 6/17 or Thu 6/18).

Anything I missed? If you want me to include a short checklist for procurement/security up front, I can attach that as well.

Best,
Marissa
